value.rationale: The recent infinite-facet construction creates a motivated geometric question: how small an interior dihedral angle must appear if all angles are almost nonobtuse? This theorem provides universal quantitative compensation, an explicit finite-facet cutoff under two-sided pinching, and the optimal square-root order for its local spherical-triangle obstruction. It is not a generic table lookup or isolated numerical calculation.
